random.seed(42)

# Count sentiments
from collections import Counter

sentiments = [r.strip() for r in results]
counts = Counter(sentiments)
print(f"Sentiment distribution (n={len(sentiments)}):")
print(f"  POSITIVE: {counts.get('POSITIVE', 0)} ({counts.get('POSITIVE', 0)/len(sentiments)*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  NEGATIVE: {counts.get('NEGATIVE', 0)} ({counts.get('NEGATIVE', 0)/len(sentiments)*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  NEUTRAL: {counts.get('NEUTRAL', 0)} ({counts.get('NEUTRAL', 0)/len(sentiments)*100:.1f}%)")

positive_pct = counts.get('POSITIVE', 0) / len(sentiments) * 100
print(f"\nMajority positive (>50%)? {positive_pct > 50} ({positive_pct:.1f}%)")
